0:
(What's this, what's this? Sugata-senpai's
giving a speech?)
1: The New World! It absolutely exists!
3:
(So Sohara's the one listening... Is she into
the New World?)
4:
You always talk about it, but what is this
New World, anyway?
5:
Hm. It is a continent that mankind has yet
to discover.
6:
But can't satellites and stuff already see
the whole Earth?
7: There may be things they cannot see...
8:
If it has not been found by now, doesn't
that mean it cannot be discovered by
ordinary means?
9: Oh, I see! Maybe you're right!
10:
The New World absolutely exists. And I will
find it.
11:
What will you do once you find the New
World?
12:
Name it after yourself or something? That
sounds kind of dreamy.
13:
A name? Hm... Once the New World is found,
it is no longer new, after all.
14: I imagine someone will slap some name on it.
15:
So you don't care about the name. Then
will you live there?
16:
Living in some uncharted land seems like
your kind of thing, Sugata-senpai.
17:
I would survey it, certainly. I would stay
there for a set period while doing so.
18: So living there isn't the goal either.
19:
Indeed... My goal is to discover the New
World. And then to survey it.
21:
I like this town, so I've never really thought
about anything like that.
24:
Ah, ahaha! Come on, Senpai! That's got
nothing to do with it!!
25:
It's peaceful, it's calm... It's a nice town,
isn't it?!
27: It is a peaceful, nice town.
28:
(Aren't you the one wrecking that peace,
Sugata-senpai?!)
29:
(Well, it's not ALL Senpai's fault, I
guess...)
30:
(Oh well. No point joining a New World
debate. Let's go somewhere else.)
